card.name: Linking words before sedation terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "the" and "and" just before the word "sedation" or "sedative" in opioid and sedative labels. It also fires on a few word pieces in sedative drug names or phrases like "minimizes".

modes.label: "of" before sedation
modes.description: The word "of" follows depth or reversal and leads into sedation or sedative effects.

modes.label: "the" before sedative effects
modes.description: The word "the" follows "reversal of" and leads into "sedative effects" in benzodiazepine reversal text.
modes.example: Flumazenil, a specific benzodiazepine receptor antagonist indicated for the complete or partial reversal of<< the>> sedative effects of benzodiazep
